5YJ.name: TESLA
5YJ.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Tesla, Inc., USA, Passenger Car.

7G2.name: TESLA
7G2.source: Added 2026-08-21 from wmi-audit.md's 'worth considering' list. NHTSA-confirmed Tesla Gigafactory Texas code, Truck vehicle type (likely Cybertruck). Prior table had no Austin production represented at all.

7SA.name: TESLA
7SA.source: Added 2026-08-21 from wmi-audit.md's 'worth considering' list. NHTSA-confirmed Tesla Gigafactory Texas code, MPV vehicle type (likely Model Y). Prior table had no Austin production represented at all.

JHM.name: HONDA
JHM.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Honda Motor Co., Ltd., Passenger Car.

JM1.name: MAZDA
JM1.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Mazda Motor Corporation, Passenger Car.

JN1.name: NISSAN
JN1.source: NHTSA confirms: Nissan Motor Company Ltd, but Make field is NISSAN, INFINITI, DATSUN. Not exclusive, still correctly attributed to Nissan.

JS2.name: SUZUKI
JS2.source: Replaces JSA, removed 2026-08-21 after wmi-audit.md caught a real error: NHTSA confirms JSA is a motorcycle WMI (Suzuki Motor of America, shared with Kawasaki), not a car code. JS2 is Suzuki's actual passenger-car/truck code, NHTSA-confirmed plain SUZUKI.

JTD.name: TOYOTA
JTD.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Toyota Motor Corporation, Make TOYOTA, Passenger Car.

JTE.name: TOYOTA
JTE.source: NHTSA confirms: Toyota Motor Corporation, but Make field is TOYOTA, LEXUS, SUBARU (Subaru builds some Toyota-platform MPVs on this WMI). Not exclusive, still correctly attributed to Toyota.

KMH.name: HYUNDAI
KMH.source: NHTSA confirms: Hyundai Motor Co, but Make field is HYUNDAI, GENESIS (Hyundai's luxury spinoff). Not exclusive, still correctly attributed.

KNA.name: KIA
KNA.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Kia Corporation, Passenger Car.

KNE.name: KIA
KNE.source: NHTSA: Count 0, absent from Kia's 9-row NHTSA list. One named source (vinspecify.com) says KNE = Korea-built Kia SUVs (Niro, Soul). Not independently corroborated by a second named source.

LB3.name: GEELY
LB3.source: NHTSA: Count 0 for LB3 (GetWMIsForManufacturer(Geely) only returns LB2, a motorcycle code under a different entity). Several decoder-site sources support LB3 = core Geely models (Coolray, Emgrand, Atlas Pro), but Wikibooks directly contradicts the LB3-vs-L6T sub-brand split (disagreeing on where Geometry and mainline Geely sit) - genuinely unresolved per wmi-audit.md. Deliberately not adding L6T: it is at least partly Zeekr's (NHTSA-confirmed, Zeekr registered its own US entity under L6T in Nov 2024), and a wrong badge is worse than no badge.

LGX.name: BYD
LGX.source: NHTSA confirms directly via DecodeWMI and GetWMIsForManufacturer: BYD Auto Co., Ltd. Also corroborated by Wikibooks and an independent CSV - the strongest-sourced Chinese-brand code in the table.

LVV.name: CHERY
LVV.source: NHTSA: no hit (expected, not sold in US). Converges across Wikibooks, an independent CSV, and a China-vehicle-history site, all agreeing LVV = Chery (Wuhu plant).

LVY.name: VOLVO
LVY.source: Added 2026-08-21 from wmi-audit.md's 'worth considering' list. NHTSA-confirmed Volvo China-built code (Daqing Volvo Car Manufacturing) - directly analogous to Tesla's Berlin code. Volvo previously had zero China-market coverage despite significant China-built export volumes (S60, S90).

SAJ.name: JAGUAR
SAJ.source: Same as SAL - NHTSA CommonName is jointly Jaguar Land Rover, secondary sources confirm SAJ = Jaguar specifically.

SAL.name: LAND ROVER
SAL.source: NHTSA confirms the code exists, but its CommonName is jointly Jaguar Land Rover, not split by brand. Secondary sources confirm SAL = Land Rover specifically within JLR's range - a real, well-documented convention just not NHTSA-native.

SB1.name: TOYOTA
SB1.source: NHTSA confirms: Toyota Motor Corporation, UK. DateAvailableToPublic 2025-11-13 - a recently-registered UK-market code, older VIN decoders may not recognize it yet.

SHH.name: HONDA
SHH.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Honda of the U.K. Mfg., Ltd. (Swindon plant).

SHS.name: HONDA
SHS.source: Added 2026-08-21 from wmi-audit.md's 'worth considering' list. NHTSA-confirmed sibling of SHH - Honda UK (Swindon), MPV vehicle type where SHH is Passenger Car. Same manufacturer, different vehicle class, was missing despite SHH being present.

SJK.name: NISSAN
SJK.source: Added 2026-08-21 from wmi-audit.md's 'worth considering' list. NHTSA-confirmed sibling of SJN (Nissan UK, Sunderland plant) - if SJN turns out unreliable, SJK is the NHTSA-backed alternative for the same plant.

SJN.name: NISSAN
SJN.source: NHTSA: Count 0, not in the live registry. Two independent secondary sources agree SJN = Nissan Motor Manufacturing UK Ltd (Sunderland). NHTSA does separately confirm sibling code SJK for Nissan UK, which lends indirect credibility.

TMA.name: HYUNDAI
TMA.source: NHTSA: Count 0, not in Hyundai's 15-row NHTSA list. Two independently-named sources agree TMA = Czech-built Hyundai (Nošovice plant).

TMB.name: ŠKODA
TMB.source: NHTSA: no hit (expected, not sold in US). Corroborated by Wikibooks, an independent CSV, dot.report, and Škoda's own official brand-story site (T=Czech Republic, M=Mladá Boleslav, B=Škoda).

TRU.name: AUDI
TRU.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Audi AG, registered under Hungary (Győr plant, where TT/A3 are historically built).

U5Y.name: KIA
U5Y.source: NHTSA confirms it exists, but as HYUNDAI-KIA AMERICA TECHNICAL CENTER INC (HATCI), Make HYUNDAI, KIA - a joint Hyundai/Kia R&D-entity code, not Kia-exclusive. Labeling it Kia is directionally fine but technically incomplete.

UU1.name: DACIA
UU1.source: NHTSA: no direct hit (expected, not sold in US). Corroborated by Wikibooks, an independent WMI CSV, and a real decoded example VIN (UU1K5220962751578 -> Dacia).

VF1.name: RENAULT
VF1.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Make EAGLE, RENAULT; Manufacturer RENAULT GROUP.

VF3.name: PEUGEOT
VF3.source: NHTSA confirms directly: DecodeWMI(VF3) and GetWMIsForManufacturer(Peugeot) both return AUTOMOBILES PEUGEOT.

VF7.name: CITROËN
VF7.source: NHTSA: Count 0 (expected). Confirmed convergently by dot.report, Wikibooks, and an independent WMI CSV. Long-established classic Citroën code.

VNK.name: TOYOTA
VNK.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Toyota Motor Manufacturing France S.A.S., Passenger Car (French Yaris plant).

VR1.name: DS
VR1.source: NHTSA: Count 0 (expected, DS not sold in US). Two independent source lineages (search summary + Wikibooks) agree.

VR3.name: PEUGEOT
VR3.source: NHTSA: Count 0 for VR3 specifically (only VF3 is registered for Peugeot). Two sources agree VR3 is a newer Stellantis-era code alongside VF3.

VR7.name: CITROËN
VR7.source: NHTSA: Count 0 (expected, Citroën not sold in US). Two source lineages (search summary + Wikibooks) agree VR7 is Citroën's newer Stellantis-era code.

VS6.name: FORD
VS6.source: NHTSA: Count 0, absent from Ford's full 78-row NHTSA list. Two-plus independent sources agree VS6 = Ford's Almussafes/Valencia, Spain plant, no contradicting source found.

VSK.name: NISSAN
VSK.source: NHTSA: Count 0. Two-plus secondary sources agree VSK = Nissan Motor Ibérica S.A. (Spain), used roughly 1993-1999, later also on Spain-built Navara D40. Possibly a stale legacy code.

VSS.name: SEAT
VSS.source: NHTSA: no hit (expected, not sold in US). Wikibooks lists VSS as SEAT/Cupra shared; an older independent WMI CSV lists SEAT only. Shared-with-Cupra claim is plausible (same Martorell plant) but not authoritatively confirmed.

W0L.name: OPEL
W0L.source: NHTSA confirms W0L = Adam Opel AG directly, with sibling codes W08/W04/W06 under the same entity. Wikibooks' claim that W0L is shared with Vauxhall is plausible but likely an oversimplification (see wmi-audit.md) - not relied on here, this entry is Opel-only.

W1K.name: MERCEDES-BENZ
W1K.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Mercedes-Benz Cars, Germany, Passenger Car.

W1N.name: MERCEDES-BENZ
W1N.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Mercedes-Benz AG, Germany, MPV/SUV line.

WA1.name: AUDI
WA1.source: Added 2026-08-21 from wmi-audit.md's 'worth considering' list. NHTSA-confirmed Audi AG, Germany, dedicated SUV/MPV-line code alongside WAU/TRU (passenger car) - covers Audi's Q-series SUVs.

WAU.name: AUDI
WAU.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Audi AG, Germany.

WBA.name: BMW
WBA.source: NHTSA confirms directly: BMW AG, Germany, Passenger Car.

WBS.name: BMW
WBS.source: NHTSA confirms directly: BMW M GMBH, Germany (BMW's M-division-specific code).

WBY.name: BMW
WBY.source: NHTSA confirms directly: BMW AG, Germany (BMW's i-series/electric code).

WDB.name: MERCEDES-BENZ
WDB.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Mercedes-Benz Cars, Germany.

WDD.name: MERCEDES-BENZ
WDD.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Mercedes-Benz Cars, Germany.

WF0.name: FORD
WF0.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Ford Werke AG, Germany, Passenger Car.

WP0.name: PORSCHE
WP0.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Dr. Ing. h.c.F. Porsche AG, Germany. Porsche's entire NHTSA-registered list is exactly {WP0, WP1}.

WP1.name: PORSCHE
WP1.source: NHTSA confirms directly: same entity as WP0, Germany, MPV (Cayenne/Macan).

WV1.name: VOLKSWAGEN
WV1.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Volkswagen, Truck type, Volkswagen Group of America Inc.

WVW.name: VOLKSWAGEN
WVW.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Volkswagen, Passenger Car, present in Volkswagen's registered manufacturer list.

XP7.name: TESLA
XP7.source: NHTSA: Count 0, absent from Tesla's 4-row NHTSA list (5YJ, SFZ, 7G2, 7SA). Five separate independent sources consistently identify XP7 as Tesla Gigafactory Berlin.

YV1.name: VOLVO
YV1.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Volvo Car Corporation, Sweden, Passenger Car.

YV4.name: VOLVO
YV4.source: NHTSA confirms directly: Volvo Car Corporation, Sweden, MPV/SUV line (e.g. XC90).

ZAR.name: ALFA ROMEO
ZAR.source: NHTSA confirms directly via DecodeWMI and GetWMIsForManufacturer: ALFA ROMEO S.P.A.

ZFA.name: FIAT
ZFA.source: NHTSA confirms directly: DecodeWMI(ZFA) -> FCA ITALY S.P.A., Make FIAT.
